senses.definition: (colloquial or derogatory) Psychotic, psychopathic, or (broadly) otherwise insane.

quotes.text: That psycho jawn had snuck a pistol into the gym while we was practicing and started shooting shit up like she was some kinda hot female action hero.
quotes.reference: 2006, Noire [pseudonym], Thug-A-Licious: An Urban Erotic Tale, New York, N.Y.: One World, Ballantine Books, →ISBN, page 258:

quotes.text: Oh, she's sweet but a psycho / A little bit psycho / At night she's screamin' / "I'm-ma-ma-ma out my mind"

senses.definition: (chiefly derogatory, slang) A person who is psychotic, psychopathic, or (broadly) otherwise insane.
examples: The loony bin up on the hill is full of psychos.

quotes.text: Oh, she's hot but a psycho / So left but she's right, though / At night she's screamin' / "I'm-ma-ma-ma out my mind"
quotes.reference: 2018, Ava Max, Madison Love, Tix, Cook Classics, Cirkut, “Sweet but Psycho”, in Heaven & Hell, performed by Ava Max:

senses.definition: (chiefly derogatory, slang, loosely) A person who acts in a bizarre or dangerous manner.
examples: She complained that he was a psycho for driving at such a high speed in heavy traffic.

senses.definition: (informal) A class, at a college or university, in which psychology is taught.
examples: I've got anthro, socio, lunch, and psycho.
